description: This file defines the LDAPService class responsible for interacting with an LDAP server for authentication purposes within the OrangeHRM system. It manages LDAP connection configuration, binding user credentials, querying LDAP entries, escaping special characters, and retrieving the EntryManager. The class utilizes Symfony LDAP components and includes methods for LDAP operations tied to user credentials and server configuration.

classes.name: LDAPService
classes.description: Service class for interacting with LDAP directory, including connection management, binding credentials, queries, and escaping special characters.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the LDAP connection object implementing ConnectionInterface.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Initializes and returns the LDAP adapter instance, configured with settings from the configuration service.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds user credentials to the LDAP connection for authentication.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Creates an LDAP query with specified DN, query string, and options.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for LDAP contexts.

methods.name: getEntryManager
methods.description: Retrieves the EntryManager instance from the LDAP adapter.
